mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause significant renal impairment; leflunomide's active metabolite is renally cleared and amphotericin B causes direct tubular damage, increasing risk of cumulative renal toxicity and leflunomide accumulation.
action: Monitor renal function closely (BUN, creatinine, electrolytes) before and during concurrent use; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation during amphotericin B therapy.
